name: Solve specific equations and math problems
description: Users asked for step-by-step solutions to specific equations, inequalities, and systems of equations, frequently specifying particular algebraic or numerical methods such as induction, Vieta's formulas, Gauss-Jordan reduction, or Newton's method. The requests covered a wide range of mathematical topics including linear, quadratic, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, and polynomial forms, as well as specific word problems requiring the setup and solution of equations.
